habitat.name: Habitat A
habitat.source: Team option A (Ronald), moved 100 m east to flat ground (1.4 deg slope)

eva_limits.label: Planning assumptions from NASA Artemis references, not Mars-certified limits

slope_policy: No terrain is forbidden for slope. Steep ground costs more and is avoided by the planner; route length steeper than 20 deg is reported as a warning (team decision).
masked: west of lon 77.35 E (DTM artefact zone; assumption from our inspection, far from this area)

frame.name: local ENU from habitat
frame.note: east_m/north_m are ground metres from the habitat. lat/lon are planetocentric degrees, longitude positive east, Mars 2000 sphere (R = 3,396,190 m). x_m/y_m are coordinates in the DTM's equirectangular projection (standard parallel 0, central meridian 0). This is NOT RFC 7946 (Earth WGS84) GeoJSON.
